headline: Claude Code Opens Its Plugin Workshop
lede: Anthropic’s official marketplace gives Claude Code a governed extension layer. Standard manifests, MCP configuration, skill bundles, and stable naming turn scattered integrations into a maintainable agent ecosystem.

headline: A Local Agent Takes On the Job Hunt
lede: AI Job Search keeps the application pipeline on the candidate’s own machine, from listing discovery to interview preparation. Structured profiles, fit scoring, tailored documents, and human review make automation accountable rather than opaque.

headline: Engineering a Repeatable Coding-Agent System
lede: ECC lays out a complete operating plan for AI-assisted software work: plan, test, implement, review, verify, and remember. Its agents, hooks, skills, and persistent memory form a documented construction kit for more disciplined automation.

headline: CLI-Anything Gives Agents the Missing Handle
lede: CLI-Anything wraps complex desktop and web applications in predictable command-line harnesses. A central hub, tested skills, input sanitization, and hardened token handling give agents a rugged path into Blender, Obsidian, Kdenlive, and more.

headline: The Field Guide for Scientific Agents
lede: Scientific Agent Skills assembles 163 validated workflows across more than 100 scientific databases. Its portable skill format connects agents to bioinformatics, drug discovery, physics, and geospatial analysis while preserving a researcher’s ability to inspect the work.

headline: AI Memory Carries Projects Across Sessions
lede: ai-memory captures agent activity, distills it into a git-backed Markdown wiki, and makes the resulting context searchable across tools and machines. Full-text, entity, link, and optional vector retrieval keep handoffs flowing without surrendering the source of truth.

headline: Android Skills Sharpen the Coding Assistant
lede: Android’s modular skill collection gives coding agents focused guidance for the parts of mobile development where they most often stumble. Install only the relevant workflows—or the full set—and let standardized SKILL.md packages activate at the right moment.

headline: Orca Coordinates a Fleet of Coding Agents
lede: Orca turns parallel agent work into an organized engineering workspace, isolating experiments in Git worktrees while keeping diffs, issues, terminals, and remote hosts in view. Desktop, mobile, SSH, and merge workflows make multi-agent development easier to operate at team scale.

headline: Claude Code Brings the Agent Into the Terminal
lede: Claude Code works directly against a project’s files, commands, and Git history instead of forcing developers into a separate browser workflow. Its terminal-first design provides a tight execution loop, with plugins extending the core assistant when the job demands it.

headline: VoiceStudio Puts a Full Voice Stack Local
lede: VoiceStudio brings voice cloning, design, dubbing, and audiobook production onto the desktop, with 16 speech-synthesis engines and 11 recognition engines to compare. CUDA, MPS/MLX, and ROCm acceleration keep the benchmark close to the hardware—and the data on the machine.
